title: An ecosystem model of the North Sea to support an ecosystem approach to fisheries management: description and parameterisation
documentation_evidence: 196-page CEFAS technical report 142, extensive group/diet/fishery parameters and calibration. Report requested citation year 2007; copyright 2008.
loadability_evidence: Native EwE loadability has not been tested. Public documentation or data availability alone does not establish a fully working reconstruction.
loadability_class: C — parameter and diet tables inspected; model import not tested
quality_rationale: Cefas PDF title verified200pages. Table3.1 printed22-23/PDF24-25 B/PB/QB/EE/unassimilated fraction and sources. Table3.4 printed29-40/PDF31-42 numerical diet matrix. No native load test. Full model import and numerical reconstruction remain untested.
extraction_readiness: Parameter and diet tables located; transcription and balance audit required
geometry_method: Selected ecosystem polygon used as intended study envelope, not a recovered author boundary
recommendation: North Sea 1991 model, approximately 570,000 km²; whole basin model.
coverage_note: North Sea 1991 model, approximately 570,000 km²; whole basin model.
